question: How large is the Twitter dataset?

evidence: We have downloaded 1,873 Twitter conversation threads, roughly 14k tweets, from a publicly available resource that were previously pre-processed and have conversation threads extracted. A conversation in the dataset consists of at least 4 tweets. Even though, according to BIBREF23, Twitter is broadly applicable to public health research, our expectation is that it contains less therapeutic conversations in comparison to specialized on-line support forums.
